parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with narrow QRS and normal PR, and I see no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria, only slight concave J-point/ST elevation with upright T waves in V3–V4 that fits early repolarization, with no reciprocal ST depression or regional Q waves, so this does not support acute STEMI.
